title: Bounded mpv cache over Demuxe browser RangeReader

definition.hypothesis: cache=yes improves bounded Hybrid/Software interruption tolerance and packet seek reuse over brange.
definition.scope_contract: Four remote VOD files, fixed decode/presentation owners, 32 MiB forward / 8 MiB back packet budgets. Native Direct behavioral reference. No production change.
definition.success_criteria: Lower network-correlated rebuffer time with equivalent output/decoder identity and bounded cache/memory; preserve counterexamples.
definition.stop_criteria: Do not make a qualified performance comparison after failed output or lifecycle gates.
definition.primary_metric: Network-correlated rebuffer duration in an eight-second throughput interruption.
definition.negative_control: Wrong-time FFmpeg reference picture and current cache=no baseline.
definition.effort_limit: Four fixtures x five configurations, targeted repeats, constrained startup and practical rate follow-up.

define.basis: Predeclared in PLAN.md before network timing.

prepare.basis: Frozen runtime and licensed media with hashes, independent RGB references, controlled Range pacing test passed.

screen.basis: All five H.264 backend/cache variants executed and cleaned up.

correctness.basis: All 22 corrected v2 cells passed independent pictures, nonzero audio, completed seeks and cleanup. Original acknowledgement-only observation failure retained and excluded from completed-seek claims.

performance.basis: 20 base 1x network trials, 5 high-bitrate repeat/tuned trials, 10 constrained cold starts, and 5 2x stress trials completed. Single-host exploratory backend results; 2x is not full fidelity qualification.

results.basis: Raw results, property/event samples, request/write logs, CPU/RSS, screenshots, fixture/runtime hashes, original observer failures and derived metrics retained.

decision.basis: Pursue further qualification: mpv cache looks promising for Hybrid/Software. Keep shipping defaults unchanged.

record.scope: Chrome 152/macOS 26.5.2, frozen Demuxe backends, four movie-derived remote MP4 fixtures, current 32/8 and tuned 24/16 MiB packet budgets.
record.reason: At 1x cache=yes removed the observed ~8s outage freezes; at 2x it reduced interruption count/duration. Same-budget tuning improved a high-bitrate back seek. Preload, byte caps, request deadlines, RTT and broader device qualification remain tradeoffs.
record.evidence_level: actual-route screen and bounded backend measurements
record.excluded_observation: One original acknowledgement-only seek picture failure; all corrected 22 cells passed.
record.recommendation: mpv cache looks promising for Hybrid/Software

next_action: Resolve the recorded Firefox Remux seek exception and qualify another low-memory device; investigate latency-amortized bounded source reads separately from cache policy.

integration.basis: User-authorized automatic portable buffering policy on main, uncommitted. Balanced mpv cache=yes 32/8 MiB; routing unchanged. Original experiment evidence and decision retained.

qualification.basis: Fresh Chrome/Firefox practical matrices, profile pictures, 18-second outage, RTT, seeks and lifecycle evidence recorded. Remaining release scope includes low-memory device/soak, full 2x fidelity, and the explicit Firefox high-bitrate Remux seek exception; see current validation report.
